0022600126.text: The Grizzlies (3-0, W3) visit the Utah Jazz (1-2, L1) for the fourth game of Memphis's season, with Memphis 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West and Utah 5th in the Northwest, 2 games back, and 11th in the West. The teams have split 2-2 in the 2025-26 season series, and Memphis leads 1-0 in 2026-27 after a 123-103 win in Memphis on October 21. Memphis is missing Karim Lopez (knee bruise) and Zach Edey (ankle), while Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise).
